# RECORD OF ADVICE

## 3. NEEDS ANALYSIS

**Motor Insurance – Vehicle 1 (2022 Toyota Land Cruiser 200)**

Client owns a high-value motor vehicle (R1,250,000) financed through FNB, therefore comprehensive cover is a contractual requirement. Vehicle is used privately within metropolitan Pretoria. Risk profile is low to moderate: vehicle is parked in a locked garage in a secure residential estate (Waterkloof); equipped with Netstar tracking device; client is a professional (architect) with stable income. Client requires comprehensive cover protecting against accidental damage, theft, hijacking, third-party liability, and loss of use. The financed status necessitates cover meeting lender requirements. Identified need: comprehensive motor insurance with competitive excess structure and adequate loss-of-use benefit.

**Motor Insurance – Vehicle 2 (2019 Volkswagen Golf 8 GTI)**

Secondary vehicle valued at R485,000, used privately, no tracking device fitted, parked in locked garage. Risk profile is moderate: vehicle is older than Vehicle 1 and lacks active security tracking. Client may elect comprehensive or third-party fire and theft cover. Given the vehicle's value and secure residential parking, comprehensive cover is recommended to protect capital investment. Identified need: comprehensive motor insurance aligned with Vehicle 1 cover for consistency and simplified claims management.

**Buildings Insurance**

Client owns primary residence valued at R3,200,000 (replacement value). Property is brick and mortar construction with concrete tile roof—standard domestic construction presenting low underwriting risk. Property is protected by electric fence and ADT alarm with armed response service, demonstrating active risk mitigation. Located in Waterkloof, Pretoria, a low-crime residential area. Client requires buildings cover protecting against fire, explosion, storm, theft, and accidental damage to the structure. Identified need: buildings insurance at declared replacement value with adequate cover limits ensuring rebuilding capacity.

**Contents Insurance**

Household contents valued at R450,000 (replacement value). Contents are stored in a secure residential dwelling with active security measures (alarm, armed response, electric fence). Risk profile is low. Client requires contents cover protecting against fire, theft, accidental damage, and specified perils affecting domestic furnishings and household goods. Identified need: contents insurance at declared replacement value with standard excess appropriate to security measures in place.

**All-Risk Personal Items**

Client possesses high-value portable items: MacBook Pro (R45,000), Rolex wristwatch (R85,000), Canon camera (R28,000). Combined value of specified items is R158,000. Risk profile for portable items is moderate to elevated due to portability and theft exposure, despite secure home storage. Client requires all-risk cover (accidental damage, theft, loss, mysterious disappearance) for these items with adequate sum insured reflecting replacement cost. Identified need: all-risk specified personal items cover protecting high-value portable possessions on a worldwide basis.

**Liability Insurance**

As homeowner and vehicle operator, client faces third-party liability exposure from slip-and-fall incidents at residential property and motor vehicle third-party claims. Personal liability limit of R1,000,000 (or higher) is appropriate given asset base (vehicles R1,735,000; property R3,200,000; contents R450,000) and professional status. Third-party motor liability is addressed through vehicle comprehensive policies. Identified need: adequate third-party liability protection integrated within buildings and motor products.

---

## 4. MARKET COMPARISON

**Insurer 1: Santam Personal Lines**

Annual premium: R38,400 (combined motor, buildings, contents, all-risk). Standard excess: R7,500 across motor and property classes. Key inclusions: comprehensive motor cover (both vehicles) with loss-of-use benefit (R200/day, 30-day limit); buildings cover at declared replacement value (R3,200,000) with accidental damage extension; contents cover at R450,000 with accidental damage; all-risk personal items cover for specified items (MacBook, Rolex, camera) with worldwide coverage and accidental damage; third-party liability R1,000,000; legal liability extension; 24-hour claims support and approved repairer network. Excess waiver available for claims-free clients. Recommendation rationale: Santam offers competitive premium pricing, streamlined cover across all asset classes, and robust claims infrastructure. Excess structure is reasonable and manageable. Product meets all identified needs comprehensively. Recommended.

**Insurer 2: OUTsurance**

Annual premium: R41,200 (combined motor, buildings, contents, all-risk). Standard excess: R5,000 (lower excess than Santam, but premium is materially higher). Key inclusions: comprehensive motor cover with loss-of-use benefit; buildings and contents cover; specified all-risk items cover; third-party liability R1,000,000. Online claims platform; competitive repairer network. Premium disadvantage outweighs lower excess structure. Not recommended rationale: Annual premium is R2,800 higher than Santam (7.3% increase) without compensating additional benefits. Excess reduction of R2,500 does not justify higher annual outlay. Client's low-risk profile and secure parking/security measures render the lower excess non-essential. Santam offers superior value proposition. Not recommended.

**Insurer 3: King Price**

Annual premium: R36,800 (combined motor, buildings, contents, all-risk). Standard excess: R7,500. Key inclusions: comprehensive motor cover; buildings and contents at declared values; all-risk personal items; third-party liability R1,000,000. Premium is lowest among three options. Not recommended rationale: Despite attractive premium pricing (R1,600 below Santam), King Price is not recommended due to industry reputation concerns regarding claims payment practices and settlement timelines. Client's high-value asset base (R3,200,000 property; R1,735,000 vehicles; R158,000 all-risk items) warrants insurer selection based on claims performance and financial stability rather than premium cost alone. Claims risk exposure is significant; Santam's superior claims reputation justifies premium differential. Not recommended.

---

# RECORD OF ADVICE
## Protea Risk Brokers (FSP 12847)
**Representative:** Marie du Plessis  
**Date of Advice:** 11 June 2026  
**Client:** Jacques Pretorius (ID: 7805125082083)

---

## 5. PRODUCT RECOMMENDED

**Insurer:** Santam Personal Lines (Homeowners Combined Policy)

**Underwriting Summary:**
Santam Personal Lines selected following comprehensive market analysis. Policy structure provides integrated buildings, contents, and motor vehicle coverage with optional all-risk portable items extension. Underwriting accepts owner-occupied brick-and-mortar residential property in secure Waterkloof location with ADT alarm system and armed response, substantially reducing risk profile.

**Buildings Cover — Section A:**
• Sum insured: R3,200,000 (replacement value basis, confirmed via quotation)
• Construction: Brick and mortar with concrete tile roof
• Location: 14 Protea Avenue, Waterkloof, Pretoria, 0181
• Security: Electric fence, ADT alarm system with armed response monitoring
• Cover includes: Reinstatement of buildings, permanent fixtures, fitted bathrooms, built-in kitchen furniture
• Exclusion — flood cover: Standard exclusion applies to water ingress from natural water sources; client advised of standing water exclusion and recommended separate flood cover if required
• Excess: Standard excess R7,500 per claim applies to all sections

**Contents Cover — Section B:**
• Sum insured: R450,000 (replacement value)
• Cover scope: Household furniture, furnishings, personal effects within buildings and ancillary structures
• Standard exclusion — cash: Maximum R5,000 cash in home excluded from cover; higher cash holdings require explicit declaration
• Standard exclusion — business stock: Home-based business equipment excluded unless separately declared
• Excess: R7,500 standard excess per claim

**All-Risk Portable Items — Optional Extension (Section C):**
• MacBook Pro: R45,000 sum insured
• Rolex wristwatch: R85,000 sum insured
• Canon digital camera: R28,000 sum insured
• Total portable items value: R158,000
• Coverage scope: Accidental loss, theft, malicious damage, mechanical/electrical breakdown whilst portable items in use or transit
• Exclusion — wear and tear: Normal deterioration of mechanical components excluded; client responsible for maintenance
• Exclusion — water damage to electronics: Damage from immersion or submersion excluded except where caused by accidental breakage of container; client advised to maintain separate contents insurance for water-immersion scenarios
• Exclusion — mysterious disappearance: Cover excluded unless caused by theft with evidence of forced entry
• Exclusion — transit in unattended vehicle: Portable items not covered if left in unattended motor vehicles unless vehicle locked with alarm activated
• Excess: R7,500 standard excess per claim; 5% co-insurance applies to recovery amounts exceeding R50,000

**Motor Vehicle Cover — Section D:**

**Vehicle 1: 2022 Toyota Land Cruiser 200**
• Registration: GP 45 RX
• Sum insured: R1,250,000 (market value basis)
• Cover type: Comprehensive (all-risk)
• Security device: Netstar tracker fitted; underwriting rating reflects improved loss recovery prospects
• Financing: Registered mortgagee FNB to receive loss payable notification
• Usage: Private use Waterkloof area and surrounding metropolitan region
• Parking: Locked garage Waterkloof — substantially reduces overnight theft risk
• Cover includes: Loss or damage from collision, theft, malicious damage, natural disasters, fire
• Exclusion — mechanical breakdown: Wear and tear, mechanical or electrical failure excluded; vehicle warranty retained for manufacturer-covered components
• Exclusion — unattended vehicle cover: Theft or malicious damage excluded if vehicle left unattended without locking doors and securing windows
• Excess: Standard excess R7,500 per claim; 10% co-excess applies to theft claims (minimum R5,000) reflecting tracker recovery potential

**Vehicle 2: 2019 Volkswagen Golf 8 GTI**
• Registration: GP 112 KL
• Sum insured: R485,000 (market value basis)
• Cover type: Comprehensive (all-risk)
• Security device: No tracking system fitted; underwriting rating reflects standard loss recovery timeline
• Financing: No mortgage listed; vehicle owned outright
• Usage: Private use Waterkloof and metropolitan area
• Parking: Locked garage (secondary residence garage arrangement noted)
• Cover includes: Collision, theft, malicious damage, fire, natural disasters
• Exclusion — mechanical breakdown: Factory-fitted mechanical components outside manufacturer warranty excluded
• Exclusion — courtesy vehicle: Santam does not provide courtesy vehicle benefit; client should arrange personal transportation during repairs
• Excess: R7,500 standard excess per claim; 10% co-excess theft claims (minimum R5,000)

**SASRIA Cover (Standardized Aggravated Risks Insurance Act 100 of 1991):**

SASRIA cover is mandatory for buildings and contents sections in South Africa. Santam Personal Lines policy includes SASRIA extension covering:

• Riot, strike, civil unrest and public disturbance
• Malicious damage arising from political violence or social unrest
• Terrorism and sabotage events
• Looting and arson in civil unrest contexts

SASRIA-covered perils are subject to:
• Separate SASRIA excess: R10,000 applies to all SASRIA-covered claims (in addition to standard excess)
• SASRIA coverage limits: Buildings and contents covered under SASRIA to 100% of sum insured
• Exclusion — unoccupied premises: SASRIA cover suspended if buildings remain unoccupied for periods exceeding 30 consecutive days; client responsible for notifying insurer of extended absences
• Exclusion — illegal occupation: SASRIA coverage void if premises occupied by illegal residents without owner consent

**Premium Structure:**

• Annual premium: R38,400 (all sections combined, inclusive of SASRIA)
• Payment method: Annual payment or monthly installment (12 × R3,200) available via debit order
• Policy commencement: 11 June 2026 (subject to underwriting acceptance and FICA verification completion)
• Renewal: Annual review required; no automatic inflation adjustment included unless premium increase notice provided 30 days prior to renewal date

**Underwriting Conditions Accepted:**

• Owner certification: Client confirms owner-occupancy status and no commercial business use
• Security maintenance: ADT alarm system and electric fence must remain operational; lapsed security monitoring may trigger premium loading or cover suspension
• Vehicle tracking: Netstar tracker subscription maintained on Land Cruiser; cessation of tracking monitoring reported to insurer within 7 days
• Property disclosure: Client confirms no material alterations to building structure, roof condition, or security arrangements since quotation date
• Fraud declaration: Client declares no previous insurance claim declines, policy cancellations, or fraud investigations with any insurer

---

## 6. REMUNERATION AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION

**Commission Structure:**

• Insurer: Santam Personal Lines
• Commission rate: 12.5% of annual premium (statutory industry rate)
• Commission quantum: R4,800 (12.5% × R38,400)
• Commission payment timing: Commission payable within 30 days of premium receipt by insurer
• Commission recipient: Protea Risk Brokers FSP 12847 (not individually retained by representative Marie du Plessis; commission paid to broking entity for internal allocation)

**Conflict of Interest Assessment:**

• No material conflict of interest identified in this transaction
• Representative Marie du Plessis holds no direct beneficial interest in Santam Personal Lines or competing insurers
• Broker entity Protea Risk Brokers holds no shareholding or financial stake in Santam or option insurers (OUTsurance, King Price)
• Commission rate uniform across all three option insurers (12.5% statutory); therefore no financial incentive to recommend Santam over alternatives
• Compliance Officer: Omega Compliance Solutions confirms no identified conflicts following FSP register cross-reference

**Disclosure of Commission Alternatives:**

Client explicitly advised that:
• 12.5% commission payable to Protea Risk Brokers regardless of insurer selection
• OUTsurance option generates identical commission (12.5% × R41,200 = R5,150)
• King Price option generates identical commission (12.5% × R36,800 = R4,600)
• Santam recommendation based on policy structure and claims reputation merit, not commission optimization

**Underwriting Relationships:**

Protea Risk Brokers maintains established relationships with all three insurers for small commercial and personal lines placement. Relationship history does not influence advice; Santam selected on advice substantiation grounds documented in Section 4 (Market Comparison).

---

## 7. REPLACEMENT ADVICE

**Not Applicable**

No existing insurance policies identified for replacement. Client confirms no prior homeowners, motor vehicle, or portable items insurance currently active. This is new business placement.

---

## 8. CLIENT ACCEPTANCE RECORD

**Advice Acceptance Confirmation:**

• Date of client acceptance: 11 June 2026
• Method of acceptance: Email correspondence (jacques@pretoriusarch.co.za)
• Client instruction: "Proceed with Santam Personal Lines quotation as presented"
• Acceptance form: Signed acknowledgment received and filed by Protea Risk Brokers

**Client Declaration:**

Jacques Pretorius confirms:
• Receipt and full understanding of this Record of Advice documentation
• Acknowledgment of all policy exclusions, excess structures, and SASRIA conditions outlined
• Acceptance of recommended Santam Personal Lines product reflecting identified needs
• Authority to proceed with policy underwriting and premium debit arrangements
• Confirmation of contact details and residential address accuracy

**Representative Certification:**

Marie du Plessis, on behalf of Protea Risk Brokers FSP 12847, confirms:
• Comprehensive needs analysis completed in accordance with FAIS Act Section 9(1) requirements
• Appropriate documentation obtained and verified (identification, proof of residence, vehicle registration)
• Market comparison undertaken across three comparable insurers with documented rationale
• Remuneration and conflict of interest disclosure provided
• Client received adequate time to review all documentation prior to acceptance instruction
• Advice documented contemporaneously and retained for FSCA inspection purposes

**Compliance Officer Sign-Off:**

Omega Compliance Solutions confirms acceptance record filed within prescribed timeframe and no FAIS compliance deficiencies identified.

**Record Storage and Retention:**

Original RoA and signed acceptance documentation retained by Protea Risk Brokers for minimum 6 years (FAIS Act Section 15 requirement). Electronic copy provided to client via email on 11 June 2026. Client entitled to request updated copy at any time during retention period.

---

**END OF RECORD OF ADVICE**

*This Record of Advice has been prepared in compliance with the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act 37 of 2002, Board Notice 80 of 2003, and General Notice 706 of 2020. It represents a contemporaneous record of advice provided and reflects the needs analysis, market comparison, and product recommendation completed for Jacques Pretorius on 11 June 2026.*

**Prepared by:** Riya, FAIS Compliance Assistant  
**For:** Protea Risk Brokers (FSP 12847)  
**Approved by:** Marie du Plessis, Representative  
**Compliance verified by:** Omega Compliance Solutions
